text:
Maria (partnerships): Hey team — we need to start the cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure for Redwood Inference. AWS is highest priority. Can we align on product packaging, required legal artifacts, and a target launch window?

Sam (solutions-eng): Quick q — are we doing SaaS metering (usage), subscription SKUs, or both? Different marketplaces have different capabilities.

Leo (product): Both. Proposed mapping:
- Hosted API -> SaaS metering (per-1000-inference-units)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) -> monthly subscription SKU (units: reserved GPU-hours / capacity tier)
- Private (VPC/on-prem) -> enterprise listing / BYOL license SKU + contact form

Aj (legal): For onboarding I need: SOC2 report (or SOC2 in progress + compensating controls), export-control classification (EAR/ITAR if applicable), DPA template, and standard T&Cs. Also confirm whether we want AWS to host billing (AWS Marketplace billing) or keep billing on our side via private offers — implications for revenue share and terms.

Sophia (cloud-partners): Note differences:
- AWS: supports SaaS Metering API and Private Offers. They want metering lambda hooks and a partner registration. Also need logos, architecture diagram, security doc.
- GCP: listing requires partner onboarding and a billing integration; they prefer subscription or usage via their marketplace API.
- Azure: supports SaaS and VM images; their marketplace has stricter cert requirements for images.

Maria (partnerships): Cool — I'll compile an artifacts checklist. Draft below:
```
- High-res logo (1200x300 PNG)
- 1-page product blurb + keywords
- Architecture diagram (PDF) showing control plane, paas/dedicated/private flows
- Security pack: SOC2 summary, pen test summary, privacy & DPA link
- Pricing matrix (SKU names, meter dimension, unit definition, MSRP)
- Support & SLA page (email, response times, escalation)
- Contact person for procurement (name/email/phone)
- Demo account + sample API key for verification (sandbox only)
```

Sam (solutions-eng): For the meter dimension — tokens are messy for marketplace metering. Suggest we define an "inference-unit" = 1k tokens (rounded) for Hosted API, and for Dedicated use "reserved-gpu-month" tiers (small/medium/large). Example SKU names: REDWOOD-HOSTED-INF-1KU, REDWOOD-DEDICATED-S1, REDWOOD-PRIVATE-LIC.

Aj (legal): Good call on inference-unit. Also check VAT/tax implications per marketplace. If we use marketplace billing, customers accept marketplace terms and refunds go through them — we need to confirm indemnity and liability caps in that flow. I'll draft a short checklist of contractual items.

Leo (product): One more product nuance: function-calling / streaming is part of Hosted API but may affect per-request metering. Recommend that streaming is meter-neutral (meter on tokens produced both directions) — document clearly. Also we should provide 2 listing packages for AWS: "Hosted API - pay as you go" and "Dedicated - reserved commit".

Sophia (cloud-partners): For GCP we may have to map meter to their usage dimension names. I'll pull GCP examples. Azure will want an offer test VM for dedicated images if we go that route.

Maria (partnerships): Action items I propose: 
- Maria: assemble artifacts (logos, diagrams, security pack) — due Fri 5/24
- Sam: prepare sandbox + sample metering lambda (AWS) and example usage meter payload — due Tue 5/21
- Aj: draft contract checklist + DPA notes — due Wed 5/22
- Leo: finalize SKU names and pricing bands + short doc on meter definitions (streaming/token rules) — due Wed 5/22
- Sophia: gather marketplace-specific docs/links for AWS/GCP/Azure and intro to partner rep — due Tue 5/21

Sam (solutions-eng): I can prototype the AWS metering lambda in a couple days — will add a small README so AWS listing team can test.

Aj (legal): Also flagging export-control question: do any of our models have restricted tech? If yes we need export classification before listing in some regions.

Leo (product): We're not shipping anything ITAR-classified, but tag this as a formal check.

Maria (partnerships): I'll book a 30m with AWS Marketplace onboarding rep for next Wed 10am PT to walk through their SaaS metering checklist. @Aj please join for the contract bits, @Sam for the metering demo, @Leo for SKU/pricing.

Sophia (cloud-partners): :thumbsup: I can set up parallel intros for GCP/Azure the same week.

deploy-bot: Reminder: "Marketplace checklist created in /confluence/marketplace/onboarding" (auto-post)

Maria (partnerships): Thanks — let's keep updates in this thread. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
